summary: Enhance your skills in health and nutrition for humanitarian relief. Join our comprehensive training course to make a meaningful impact in crisis situations.
lede: Humanitarian health and nutrition response training covers assessing risks and organizing services during emergencies. It is for professionals who plan, manage, supervise, or report on relief initiatives, and addresses the practical work of turning needs into coordinated care through rapid assessment and indicator use, nutrition screening and referral planning, and integrated health, nutrition, water, sanitation, and hygiene services with monitoring and supply tracking.
audienceIntro: This course is meticulously designed for a diverse range of professionals engaged in planning, managing, supervising, or reporting on humanitarian health and nutrition initiatives.
audience: Program managers and project officers in humanitarian
Nutrition officers, health officers, and MEAL
Private sector CSR and foundation teams
modules: Rapid Needs Assessment and Risk Analysis
Nutrition Screening, Targeting, and Referral Pathways
Management of Acute Malnutrition and CMAM Operations
Maternal, Infant, and Young Child Feeding in Emergencies
Emergency Health Services and Integrated Primary Care
Disease Prevention, Outbreak Preparedness, and IPC Basics
Supply Chain and Commodity Management for Health and Nutrition
MEAL for Health and Nutrition Outcomes
Coordination, Standards, and Accountability to Affected Populations
Designing Response Plans, Budgets, and Donor-Ready Justification
prerequisites: Participants should have a background in public health, nutrition, humanitarian response, or a related field. Experience in humanitarian settings is recommended but not required. Basic understanding of humanitarian principles and emergency response mechanisms is beneficial.
